scope: Fresh synthetic matched-effect diagnostic only; no manuscript reads, H/F separate.
design: 100fresh layouts for each density.35/.70 x variablelength6..14/fixed12 x bodypool1/12;12pages24lines,2%unknownslots. Seeds1090000+cell*1000+trial. Actual token arrays, no overwritten origins.
matching: Unchanged allinterior body-only maximumweight pairing, exactpage/length/body groups. Identify discordant groups with0<k<n before outcomes. Vg=k(n-k)/n. Matched contrast defined as Vg-weighted mean of group sh-following-qok rate minus ch-following-qok rate, across those groups only. This effect summary is explicit; exacttest statistic remains total sh*qok.
calibration: Compute Vg-weighted available-follower fractions f_ch,f_sh within movablegroups, including structural-zero followers. Target weighted rates .10 and .25; assign available matched followers probabilities .10/f_ch and .25/f_sh. Require totalV>0 and fractions>=targets; otherwise record no_support or infeasible without positive scoring. Uniform draws only after matching/calibration. This calibrates weighted aggregate, not eachgroup. Save analytic expectation and realized weighted contrast.
controls: For every layout run independent null: qokprob.2 on all available nonorigins, no prefix-conditioned calibration. For feasible positive place target probabilities on matched followers; unmatched available followers prob.2. Matched corner followers cannot overlap between origins. Qok never replaces origins/unknowns. Verify matching/support unchanged by generated outcomes.
gates: Per cell100attempts: positive practical-power denominator includes no_support/infeasible failures; require Wilson95 lower>=.80. Report feasible-only power separately. Null upper<=.10; constant-score cases not negativeevidence. Anygatefailure retained; no qualification or scoring of manuscript. No reruns/repair after outcomes.
